Former fighter turned comedian Brendan Schaub returns to Joe Rogan for episode 2498. Schaub is a longtime regular in Rogan's world. Their talks mix fight shop with pure bro humor.

The pair trade stories from gyms, stages, and podcast studios. Schaub shares his latest takes on fights and fame. Rogan teases him like an old training partner. The episode is loose and familiar by design. Fans of their shared shows get exactly the hang they came for, with no need for a topic at all. Old friends need no topic to fill three hours.
